questions.question:
Select the most suitable expression that can substitute the underlined part of the sentence without any change in meaning.
Planning to go for a movie just before the final-year examination is nothing but Skating on thin ice
questions.solution: B)Skating on thin ice–being in a risky situationजोखिम भरी स्थिति में होना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate segment to substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.
The referee declared that the participant who will score the highest points in the tally will take away the cash prize of ₹50 lakh.
options: 1) who can score the highest point
3) who could score the highest point
4) who settles scores the highest point
questions.solution:
B) 'will score'के बदले 'scores' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि यह एक conditional statement है जो भविष्य की घटना को संदर्भित करता है। मुख्य Clause 'will take away' का उपयोग करता है, इसलिए Relative Clause में Simple Present Tense 'scores' का उपयोग उचित है; जैसे— The referee declared that the participant who scores the highest points in the tally will take away the cash prize of ₹50 lakh.
'scores' will be used instead of 'will score' because it is a conditional statement referring to a future event. The main clause uses a future form 'will take away', so the Simple Present Tense 'scores' is appropriate in the Relative Clause; Like— The referee declared that the participant who scores the highest points in the tally will take away the cash prize of ₹50 lakh.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
My friends are on a trip to the world
questions.solution: D) Around the world(phrase) – Throughout the world; all over the world.विश्वभरमें

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
An awkward neither grammatically accurate sentence is the result of centre implanting.
questions.solution:
A)'neither'के बदले 'but' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'awkward' और 'grammatically accurate' वाक्य में विरोधाभास को दर्शाने के लिए 'but' उपयुक्त conjunction है; जैसे— An awkward but grammatically accurate sentence is the result of center-implanting.
'but' will be used instead of 'neither' because 'awkward' and 'grammatically accurate' in the sentence show a contrast, so 'but' is the appropriate conjunction; Like— An awkward but grammatically accurate sentence is the result of center-implanting.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate segment to substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.
Youth is the time when the seeds of character is sown
options: 1) the seeds of character will have been sowing
2) the seeds of character had been sown
3) the seeds of character were sown
4) the seeds of character are sown
questions.solution:
D)is'के बदले 'are' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'the seeds' Subject Plural है और इसके साथ Verb भी Plural होगा; जैसे— 'the seeds of character are sown'.
'are' will be used instead of 'is' because 'the seeds' is a Plural Subject, so the Verb will also be in Plural form; Like— 'the seeds of character are sown'.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
I prefer walking than riding
questions.solution:
A)than'के बदले 'to' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'prefer' के साथ 'to' का प्रयोग किया जाता है; जैसे— I prefer tea to coffee.
'to' will be used instead of 'than' because with 'prefer', 'to' is used; Like— I prefer tea to coffee.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
Shakespeare is great than any other English poet.
questions.solution:
B) 'is great' के बदले 'was greater' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि तुलना Past Tense में हो रही है; जैसे— Shakespeare was greater than any other English poet.
• 'was greater' will be used instead of 'is great' because the comparison is being made in the Past Tense; Like— Shakespeare was greater than any other English poet.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.
The culprit had been shot from the back by the police inspector
questions.solution:
B)'from'के बदले 'in' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि संदर्भ में बताया गया है कि गोली पीठ में लगी थी; जैसे— The culprit had been shot in the back by the police inspector.
'in' will be used instead of 'from' because the context suggests that the bullet hit in the back; Like— The culprit had been shot in the back by the police inspector.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
The author’s writing style is characterised by its poetic language.
questions.solution:
A)'poetic language'के बदले 'lyrical language' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'lyrical' का अर्थ भी 'poetic' होता है; अत: यह सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प है; जैसे— The author’s writing style is characterised by its lyrical language.
Lyrical(adjective) – like a song or a poem, expressing strong personal feelings आत्‍माभिव्‍यंजक गीत या कविता के समान; प्रगीत
'lyrical language' will be used instead of 'poetic language' because 'lyrical' also means 'poetic'; hence, it is the most appropriate option; Like— The author’s writing style is characterised by its lyrical language.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.
If I was very rich , I would spend all my time and money for the poor
questions.solution:
B)was'के बदले 'were' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि condition statement में Verb 'were' का प्रयोग Subjunctive Mood में होता है; जैसे— If I were a bird, I would fly in the sky.
'were' will be used instead of 'was' because in a conditional statement the verb 'were' is used in Subjunctive Mood; Like— If I were a bird, I would fly in the sky.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
No sooner had she finished her breakfast that she had received a phone call from her boss, informing her that she needed to come to work immediately
questions.solution:
D)that she had received'के बदले 'than she received' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि ‘No sooner’ के बाद 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'that' का, और यह sentence Past Tense में है; अत: Verb भी Past Tense में होगा; जैसे— No sooner had she finished her breakfast than she received a phone call from her boss, informing her that she needed to come to work immediately.
than she received' will be used instead of 'that she had received' because after 'No sooner', 'than' is used, not 'that', and this sentence is in Past Tense; so the Verb will also be in Past Tense; Like— No sooner had she finished her breakfast than she received a phone call from her boss, informing her that she needed to come to work immediately.

questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.
My friend vanished when the goons came to fight with me.
questions.solution:
B)'disappeared when the thugs arrived'काप्रयोगहोगाक्योंकिपूरेसंदर्भमें, sentenceकातात्पर्ययहहैकिदोस्तउससमयअचानकगायबहोगयाजबगुंडेआए।यहाँ'vanished'कासहीपर्यायवाची'disappeared'है,और'goons'केबजाय'thugs'काउपयोगअधिकउपयुक्तहै।इसलिए, "disappeared when the thugs arrived"सबसेउपयुक्तविकल्पहोगा।
‘disappeared when the thugs arrived' should be used because in the entire context, the sentence implies that the friend suddenly vanished when the thugs came. Here, 'disappeared' is the correct synonym for 'vanished,' and using 'thugs' instead of 'goons' is more appropriate. Thus, "disappeared when the thugs arrived" would be the most suitable choice.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate segment to substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.
After he leave, we discussed his suggestion
questions.solution:
C) 'He leave' के बदले 'he had left' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि मुख्य Clause 'we discussed' Past Tense में है, अत: 'after' Clause में भी Past Perfect Tense का प्रयोग होना चाहिए। सही वाक्य इस प्रकार होगा: "After he had left, we discussed his suggestion."
'He had left' will be used instead of 'he leave' because the main clause 'we discussed' is in the Past Tense, so the 'after' clause should use the Past Perfect Tense. The correct sentence should be: "After he had left, we discussed his suggestion."

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.
Though very informative, Shweta’s article was mercilessly rejected of the editor
questions.solution:
D) Was mercilessly rejected of'के बदले 'was mercilessly rejected by' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि Preposition 'by' का प्रयोग Verb 'rejected' के बाद उचित है। जैसे— The article was mercilessly rejected by the editor.
'was mercilessly rejected by' will be used instead of 'was mercilessly rejected of' because the Preposition 'by' is appropriate after the Verb 'rejected'. Like— The article was mercilessly rejected by the editor.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
Rajan’s caused extremely painful headaches
questions.solution: A)extremely painful' के बदले'excruciating'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'excruciating' का अर्थ है 'अत्यंत पीड़ादायक', जो 'extremely painful' का सही substitute है; जैसे— The pain was so excruciating that he couldn't move.
